_**User (2026-10-27 01:12:07Z)**_

Review this PR for any major issues.

<pasted_content id="5aa0">
Description
This PR fixes the failing lint CI test. I simply ran "yarn lint --fix" which fixed a lot of lint errors we allowed to get into the main branch before fixing the CI tests. I also added the ai-logs and docs files to be ignored by lint in the future, that way we keep their original specstory format, and they don't need to be fixed by lint.

Further, knip tests were failing, and this was failed by simply ignoring five babel dependencies. To see changes, check the changes to the knip.json file

I didn't use AI on this, these were all pretty straight forward fixes, just took some digging to figure out the knip stuff.
</pasted_content id="5aa0">

import type * as BabelTypes from '@babel/types';
import type { Attribute, Options } from '@svgr/babel-plugin-add-jsx-attribute';

type PluginAPI = {

  template: typeof BabelTemplate;
};

const positionMethod = {
  start: 'unshiftContainer',
  end: 'pushContainer',
} as const;

const addJSXAttribute = ({ types: t, template }: PluginAPI, opts: Options) => {
  function getAttributeValue({
    literal,
    value,
  }: Pick<Attribute, 'literal' | 'value'>):
    | BabelTypes.JSXExpressionContainer
    | BabelTypes.StringLiteral
    | null {
    if (typeof value === 'boolean') {
      return t.jsxExpressionContainer(t.booleanLiteral(value));
    }

    if (typeof value === 'number') {
      return t.jsxExpressionContainer(t.numericLiteral(value));
    }

I found no major issues. The PR is safe to merge.

**What changed**
- **47 source files:** formatting and import-order fixes only. I checked the whole diff and none of it changes behavior: long JSX `style` props are wrapped, imports are re-sorted, newlines are added at end of file, and `FontSizeSettings.tsx` is re-indented.
- **[app.test.ts](packages/loot-core/src/server/preferences/app.test.ts):** this is the only edit beyond whitespace. `vi.mock('#server/main', …)` now sits below the imports, which is fine because Vitest moves `vi.mock` calls to the top before running anything. The new comment says this correctly. I ran the file and all 4 tests pass.
- **[knip.json](knip.json):** the fix is correct. [add-attribute.ts](packages/component-library/src/icons/add-attribute.ts) imports only types from `@babel/template`, `@babel/traverse` and `@babel/types`. Knip is already set to skip that file, so it can't see those imports and wrongly flags the packages as unused. Adding them to `ignoreDependencies` follows the existing `@svgr/babel-plugin-add-jsx-attribute` entry. One small correction to the description: it says five babel dependencies, but the diff adds three.
- **[.oxfmtrc.json](.oxfmtrc.json):** `ignorePatterns: ["ai-logs/**", "docs/**"]` only matches the top-level folders. I checked, and `packages/docs/` (the real docs site) is still format-checked.

**Small notes on the description**
1. It says the AI logs and docs are "ignored by lint." Only the formatter (oxfmt) skips them; oxlint was not changed. That's fine, because those folders hold only `.md`, `.pdf` and `.png` files, which oxlint doesn't check anyway.
2. The command to auto-fix is `yarn lint:fix`. `yarn lint --fix` runs `oxfmt --check` first, which only reports formatting problems and doesn't fix them. The result is the same here, but the right command is worth stating for anyone repeating this.

**Verification**
Run on this Windows machine, `yarn lint` and `yarn knip` both still fail. Those failures come from Windows-style line endings in this local copy (`yarn.config.cjs` and `.husky/pre-commit` show CRLF), not from the PR:
- Lint flags 487 files across the repo, including files this PR never touches.
- Knip's leftover complaint about `nano-staged` comes from the `.husky/pre-commit` script being read with a stray carriage return (`nano-staged\r`).
- Neither tool reports anything in `ai-logs/`, `docs/`, or the three babel packages.

There's no PR open for `fix/ci-lint` yet, so nothing has run in CI. CI on Linux uses normal line endings, so I'd expect both checks to pass, but open the PR and confirm the checks go green to be sure.
